# AI Rumpelstiltskin

> AI Rumpelstiltskin is an independent, browser-based creative tool that turns your own photos into short AI dance videos in the viral "Rumpelstiltskin" meme format. Users upload one or two photos, optionally describe a scene, and receive a 9-second video in which the characters of a reference template dance with their faces and outfits.

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Independent creative project — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the original creators of the Rumpelstiltskin AI meme, nor to any real person appearing in the reference templates.
- All output videos are AI-generated. They are not real footage and are not statements or endorsements by the people depicted.
- Videos are 9 seconds long. Users choose landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square (1:1).
- Generation is powered by third-party AI video models (fal.ai, Kling O3 reference model) and typically takes 5–15 minutes.
- Users must have rights to the photos they upload and consent from every identifiable person depicted.
- Interface languages: English (default) and Chinese (/zh).

## Credits and pricing

- 1 generated video costs 100 credits.
- Unused credits never expire. Failed generations are refunded automatically.
- One-time packs: $9.99 for 100 credits; $24.99 for 300 credits.
- Monthly subscription: $39.99/month for 600 credits per month; cancel renewal anytime.
- Payments are processed by Stripe. Sign-in via email or Google. Credits are stored per account.
